name: Tsushima Seiji
source:
Tsushima is the school doctor at Takumi and Jun's school. He has a relationship with Oohira, which seems to be linked back to their school days. Whether he wants the relationship or is using Oohira for no good is a different matter...

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/kioku/kioku.php]Boys' Love Game Headquarters[/url]]
